varieties.dialect: Saudi or Gulf dialect in Arabic letters; English tech words written in Arabic letters count as dialect (أبلكيشن، داتابيس).
varieties.msa: Modern Standard Arabic in Arabic letters only.
varieties.mixed: An Arabic sentence (dialect or standard) with English words in Latin letters. lang is ar.

labellingRules.evidence: A capability is expected when the text says the student did the work. A wish or plan (أبغى أتعلم، ودي أشتغل، I want to learn), attending an event or course without doing the work, and other people's work are not evidence: should-abstain.
labellingRules.database: Designing a database, its tables, keys or relations, or writing queries. Operating it (backup, restore, permissions) is db-operations.
labellingRules.systems-analysis: The text shows how work flows through a system or an organisation: who does what and in which order, between at least two roles, with at least three steps or hand-offs; or analysing current processes with the people who do them.
labellingRules.requirements: The text states what a system the student built, designed or specified does or must do (at least two of its functions), or the student gathered or wrote requirements, user stories or acceptance criteria.
labellingRules.other capabilities: As named in their descriptions (eval/project-suggest/skill-descriptions.json). Building a system without programming detail is not software engineering on its own.
